title: Hamster wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='hamBody' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f7c873'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d99a3c'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='24' fill='url(#hamBody)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#fbe9c4'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='33' r='9' fill='#e0a84a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='33' r='5' fill='#f9bcd0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='33' r='9' fill='#e0a84a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='33' r='5' fill='#f9bcd0'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='27' ry='23' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#fbe9c4'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='55' r='6' fill='#f28fa8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='55' r='6' fill='#f28fa8'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='43.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='45' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='43.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose & mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#e07a92'/>
  <path d='M50 57 v3 M50 60 q-4 3 -7 0 M50 60 q4 3 7 0' stroke='#b5652f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M27 52 l-10 -3 M27 56 l-11 2 M73 52 l10 -3 M73 56 l11 2' stroke='#c98636' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='85' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f9d9a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='85' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f9d9a8'/>

  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M42 26 L50 6 L58 26 Z' fill='#5b8def'/>
  <path d='M42 26 L50 6 L50 26 Z' fill='#7aa8f5'/>
  <path d='M44 21 L56 21' stroke='#ffd45e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M46 16 L54 16' stroke='#ff7fb0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='3.5' fill='#ffd45e'/>
  <path d='M42 26 q8 4 16 0' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
</svg>
